input.body: We are writing to request a review of the deduction of $18.75 on DoorDash order DD-48230 from 2026-11-04, which was applied for a missing item (Green Smoothie). Our order ticket for DD-48230 lists the Green Smoothie, which shows the item was part of the order as placed; on its own it does not show how the order was packed [DD-48230:ticket_lists_item]. Our records show the order was ready at 13:24 and was picked up by the courier at 13:29, five minutes later [DD-48230:pickup_handoff]. This means the order left our restaurant with the courier after it was ready. We are sharing only what our records show and have no further information about what happened after handoff. We kindly ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. Thank you for your time and consideration.
